system: Mortgage Criteria Platform (synthetic): multi-tenant AI criteria search and decision support for UK brokers
notes: Synthetic design-stage model. Tenant = broker firm. All mitigations are planned; nothing has been implemented or verified. ASVS IDs were chosen by chapter/section title from the bundled ASVS 5.0.0 index and must be confirmed against the requirement text before use.

components.name: Platform API (criteria search, affordability, assistant orchestration)
Tenant case database (shared schema, tenant_id column)
Lender criteria store (versioned rules, shared across tenants)
Document parsing worker (uploaded payslips and statements)

assets.name: Broker client case facts (consumer personal and financial data)
Lender criteria rules and source references
LLM prompts and completions with redacted case context
Audit log of results, overrides and challenges

mitigations.description: MFA for all broker users; rate limiting on login

threats.title: Tampering with case facts in transit
Session token disclosure via insecure cookie
Search flooding exhausts capacity for all broker firms
Broker changes tenant_id in a request to read another firm's cases

mitigations.description: Tenant derived from session, never from request; object-level authorisation on every case read

threats.title: SQL injection through case search modifies tenant data

mitigations.description: Parameterised queries only; no string-built SQL

threats.title: Query missing tenant filter returns another firm's client cases

mitigations.description: Row-level security keyed on tenant_id plus repository-layer filter and cross-tenant tests

threats.title: Unbounded case export query exhausts the shared database
Instructions hidden in an uploaded document steer the assistant (indirect prompt injection)

mitigations.description: Injection screening before context assembly; retrieved content can never trigger side-effecting tools; model output treated as untrusted

threats.title: Client case data retained or reused by the LLM provider

mitigations.description: Identifier redaction before prompts; data processing agreement with zero-retention setting; minimise fields sent

threats.title: One firm's case context included in another firm's assistant prompt

mitigations.description: Context assembled per request from tenant-scoped queries only; no shared prompt cache across tenants

threats.title: LLM provider outage blocks criteria search

mitigations.description: Rules engine and affordability work without the assistant; assistant degrades to off

threats.title: Unauthorised change to a lender rule alters results for every firm

mitigations.description: Four-eyes rule change with lender contact approval; criteria validation before load; change audit log

threats.title: Disclosure of lender criteria to unauthenticated users

mitigations.description: Criteria store reachable only from the API tier
Read replica; search returns refer when criteria cannot be loaded

threats.title: Malicious document content alters parsed income figures

mitigations.description: Parsed figures shown to the broker for confirmation before use; hidden text stripped before parsing

threats.title: Parsing worker writes a document into the wrong tenant

mitigations.description: Tenant ID carried in a signed job envelope and re-checked by the worker

threats.title: Oversized or compressed upload exhausts the parsing worker

mitigations.description: File size and type limits at upload

threats.title: Broker disputes having overridden or relied on a result

mitigations.description: Audit log of results, overrides and challenges with user and time
